name: ShowOps Agent
author: ShowOps
description: Connects this FPP player to your ShowOps account at api.showops.io for monitoring and remote management. When you enable them, ShowOps can ask the agent to set FPP's restart or reboot banner, upgrade FPP or the OS, restore configuration, change playlists and schedules, and upload configuration and log archives with passwords removed. Remote support can open a Cloudflare Tunnel to this player's FPP web UI (cloudflared is fetched from github.com and pinned). The agent is closed source and does not replace its own binary. Pair only on a trusted network. Raspberry Pi and BeagleBone (ARM) only.

privacy.summary: Connects this player to your ShowOps account for monitoring. Backups, location, diagnostics, and remote support stay off until you turn them on.

sends.what: player name, FPP version, playback, and disk and CPU use
sends.why: to show this player in your ShowOps account

sends.what: a hash of this player's machine id and MAC addresses
sends.why: to recognize this player when you pair it
to place the show on a map when you enable location

sends.what: installed plugins, network details, and FPP logs
sends.why: to troubleshoot this player when you enable diagnostics

sends.what: a configuration backup with passwords removed
sends.why: to restore this player when you enable backups

systemChanges.what: Runs the ShowOps agent as the fpp user via systemd
Plugin install downloads the closed-source agent and pinned cloudflared
Remote support can open a Cloudflare Tunnel to this player's web UI
Can set FPP restart and reboot banners, playlists, and upgrades when you confirm
Backup reads FPP settings and removes passwords before anything is uploaded
Restarts the ShowOps service with FPP's sudo helper. Stops fppd through FPP's API

privacy.other: Pair only on a trusted network. Pairing credentials stay in plugindata until Unpair. The agent does not replace its own binary. Remote support is signed in through ShowOps, opened from the cloud, and idle-limited. cloudflared stays on the pinned 2024.8.3 build. A session can reach another LAN host only when that host is on the player's allowlist.
